nom: Philosophy Hope In A Jar Biome-Balance Glow Serum

avis.titre: Would be nice if I received it
avis.texte: First off, I love this product. Ordered it and I received an empty bottle. You refunded my $. Ordered 2 more when back in stock, never received them. They are marked as delivered, but not to me. I will be calling customer service in the morning
Philosophy hope in a jar blame/balance glow serum is good for hydration and glow. It absorbs quickly and no stickiness on face. This serum change my over all face moisture and texture.

avis.titre: For more hydrated, soft, and radiant skin
avis.texte: Its ultra-light, gel-like texture is designed to glide easily onto the skin. It feels fresh upon application and leaves no sticky or greasy residue. Thanks to its base, it is rich in boosters and absorbs quickly when pressed onto the skin, leaving no residue or heavy film. It provides immediate hydration, leaving skin soft and smooth, and enhances natural radiance.
This serum feels rich, silky, and luxurious on the skin. A little goes a long way, and it leaves my face looking radiant and healthy. Definitely gives spa-quality results at home.

I've used this serum for 20 years. Philosophy has tweaked the formula over the years, but in my experience it's still the best product for me. I've tried other serums and always come back to Philosophy's Hope In A Jar serum.

avis.titre: I'm trying this for the first time and I like it.
avis.texte: So far so good. My first time using this product I don't have a long history to share, but it seems really good.

avis.titre: Leaves you with beautiful and glowing skin!
avis.texte: This serum has helped my skin so much. As someone who struggles with extremely dry skin it definitely helps bring some moisture to the skin! If you do have oily skin, it is still a great option but may leave you a little shiny! Doesn't have a strong scent either! Packaging is also nice and aesthetically pleasing to the eye!

I actually love this product. I have very sensitive skin and it has not broken me out. Makes my skin feel very hydrated and I would recommend. I use this before I apply my makeup and the results and Awsome. 10/10

I have been loving this serum. It is lightweight and very hydrating. It absorbs quickly, doesn't leave the skin sticky, and makes the skin look healthy. Love everything I've tried from this brand so far. I def recommend.

The philosophy hope serum has been a game changer in my skincare routine!! It is super lightweight and absorbs beautifully into my skin. My skin feels bouncier and I genuinely believe it is helping repair my skin barrier! I have also noticed my complexion has a beautiful and soft glow since implementing this serum into my skincare routine. I will definitely be repurchasing!!!
I've been using this product for a number of years now and would NEVER trade it for another. After washing with the cleanser my face feels clean and smooth - everytime time.

Pros: lightweight formula, almost watery. Not sticky on the skin and absorbs quickly. Glass bottle is a nice touch and the applicator works fine. Cons: So. Much. Fragrance. It was just too much for me in a fave serum.

avis.titre: Good serum- not scented which is a plus
avis.texte: This is a really nice serum for adding hydration to the skin. I love that it doesn't have any scent— some products are too over scented. It doesn't break me out and I notice my skin feels smoother and is more hydrated with usage. I would recommend.

The packaging is so sleek and luxurious. I tried the serum for two weeks now. I love how it makes my skin look and feel! My skin is so soft and I'm receiving compliments on how it looks. I can see some fine lines and wrinkles fading away! Its helped with reducing skin crepe on my neck . It also layers perfectly under makeup and doesn't break my foundation. I received the product for free from Influenster and Philosophy in exchange for my honest review

avis.titre: My face just looks fresh and happy
avis.texte: This serum has been such a nice addition to my routine. It gives great hydration, and my skin feels super soft and looks way more refreshed and healthy after using it.

avis.titre: I really wanted to like this product
avis.texte: Even with consistent use, I didn't see any effect from this product. It was light and easy to apply, absorbed easily, no offensive scent, but I won't keep using it. I've used Philosophy products on and off for years and have largely been pleased with the results. There are a couple that I always know I can come back to and have good results with, but this won't be one of those. I still plan to continue to try their new products in the future.

I have been using this serum in the mornings followed up by spf, I really like the fact this is a lightweight serum that doesn't make my skin oily or pills. My skin seems to be more glowy than before, it does have a scent but it goes away almost immediately, I personally don't mind it and didn't get any reaction to it. I think it helps brighten and keep my skin barrier happy.

I really enjoyed using the Philosophy Biome-Balance Glow Serum. It's incredibly lightweight and gentle—perfect for my sensitive skin. It gave my skin a healthy, hydrated look and feel without any irritation. There's no noticeable scent, which I appreciated, and it layered easily under other products. If you're looking for a simple, soothing serum that delivers a dewy glow, this one's a solid pick.

There is no scent to it. Love that. Texture is smooth doesn't burn or feel like it's drying at all my skin looks amazing so I would say it's showing it works and the package size is great a good like bottle
Love this product! It made my skin feel so smooth and look so glowy! The packaging felt luxurious. Also loved that there was no strong scent. Did not irritate my sensitive skin!

avis.titre: Hydrating Glow That Doesn't Clog Pores!
avis.texte: I've been using the Philosophy Biome-Balance Glow Serum every day or every other day, both in the AM and PM. My skin has a lot of redness and acne and some dry spots. I can definitely feel and see a difference since I've been using this. It gives my skin a nice, hydrating glow without being greasy or heavy. The serum feels really nice and absorbs well, leaving my skin looking much more radiant. I checked the ingredients for pore-clogging risks, and thankfully, it passed the test!

As a beauty enthusiast with dry skin and a constant battle with hyperpigmentation, I was thrilled to receive Philosophy's latest release in the "Hope" collection: Hope In A Jar Biome-Balance Glow Serum — #Complimentary from Influenster and Philosophy in exchange for my honest review. All thoughts are entirely my own. I immediately integrated this glow serum into my skincare routine. With its thoughtful ingredient list and Philosophy's commitment to clean beauty, I was genuinely excited to give it a try and hopeful to see visible results. I really appreciate that Philosophy formulates with clean ingredients, uses sustainable packaging, and is proudly cruelty-free. This serum's packaging is made from 100% recycled materials and comes in a luxe glass jar with a dropper — a small detail that adds a touch of elegance to my skincare shelf. The star ingredients include hyaluronic acid for deep hydration and prebiotics to help balance the skin's microbiome. But what really caught my attention is AA2G — Philosophy's patented, stable form of vitamin C. It promises to brighten the complexion and reduce the appearance of dark spots, which is exactly what my skin needs. The serum itself is clear with a pleasant, lightweight texture. It claims to be lightly scented, but I didn't notice much of a fragrance — which I appreciate. It feels incredibly refreshing, absorbs beautifully, and layers seamlessly with the rest of my skincare and even under foundation. No greasiness, no pilling, and no
The scent is okay. I like the light texture of this. The packaging makes it very easy to distribute. I'm still waiting to see how well this works, but I'm hopeful!

This serum is very lightweight and has a nice light clean smell to it. I press it into my skin to apply, and it's not sticky like some serums can be. After a few weeks of use, my skin feels softer, smoother, and more plump, as I have been losing elasticity getting older. I use about 4 drops from the dropper every am and pm. Nifty product!
Seriously makes my skin glow. I just wish it came in a bigger bottle!

I really like the texture of this product. Very light and absorbs quickly. I do feel like it added moisture and glow to my skin with consistent use. One day I forgot to put moisturizer on and I almost didn't even notice because the serum and added a nice hydration to my skin. It has no scent and lasts awhile. It's a little pricier than I would normally spend on skincare, so I'm not sure if I'll purchase it again. But you get what you pay for and I do feel like this serum is worth it.
Love this stuff. Super lightweight and makes my skin feel so hydrated. Really love the way it looks and feels on my skin. Would definitely recommend!

avis.titre: Love the smell, soft on skin
avis.texte: This smells sooooo good to me. It's soft and cool on my skin. The pipette is easy to use and grabs just the right amount to cover my face. Overall, a nice serum that keeps my skin hydrated before I take on the outdoors.

This serum comes in a nice glass dropper bottle and is very watery-like in texture. It's super light leaving no sticky or greasy residue. This serum is perfect if your skin needs a good boost of hydration! This serum helped my skin feel hydrated while providing a nice glow. It sinks in my face very nicely and makes my skin feels nourished and moisturized. I used it two times a day for the last few days and it made such a difference. I've been impressed from day 1 of using this product and couldn't live without it now. My skin feels so much smoother and definitely looks brighter too.

avis.titre: Great for skin support and glow!
avis.texte: This works beautifully with my more on the dry side, dull, sensitive skin! Some glow serums I have tried irritated my skin but this one didn't at all. It's incredibly lightweight and absorbs quickly without being sticky or tacky. It does have a very faint scent at first but it dissappears fast. My skin has a beautiful glow to it since I been using this and makes me look forward to when I get to apply it again everyday. Gives me a perfect level of hydration and leaves my skin soft and smooth as well as glowy, honestly one of my new favorite skin products! Hydration, a beautiful glow, and barrier support in one product that works and doesn't irritate my sensitive skin, YES! It is a bit pricier but I think it's reasonable for the benefits and the bottle will last a while as only need a couple drops. This is one I will definitely be continuing to use!

I received this product for free from Influenster in exchange for my honest opinion. Serum is an important step in my skin care routine but it is difficult to truly know of it's working. However, I did enjoy this serum as it had a good body to it and absorbed wonderfully. There is no smell to it which I enjoyed.

avis.titre: Wasn't expecting much but I'm surprised!
avis.texte: This is the first Philosophy product I've used but it certainly won't be the last. I have been enjoying using this light serum as part of my nighttime routine. It is weightless and leaves my face feeling fresh. I use 4 drops before my moisturizer and I find that it absorbs quickly. It has a faint perfume-y scent that is imperceptible after a few seconds. I have combination skin that tends to be oily when I wake up, but I have noticed that my face looks brighter, but not greasy, in the morning after using the product. I would definitely recommend this serum!

Gives your skin a super hydrated and glassy look, obsessed! It has a subtle clean smell that goes away pretty quick after applying, and it leaves my face feeling moisturized and hydrated. The dropper is also very helpful for not using too much at a time.

Philosophy Hope in a Jar Biome Balance Glow Serum I've been using this serum for a few weeks now, and I'm really impressed. It feels super lightweight on the skin and absorbs quickly without leaving any sticky residue. My skin looks more refreshed and has a subtle glow, especially in the morning. I love that it includes prebiotics and hyaluronic acid, my skin feels more balanced and hydrated. Definitely a nice addition to my routine!

Just started using it about half a week ago. Too early to see the effects of a product, but initial impression is good. Opposed to some other serums with a thicker texture, this serum is watery. It smells just like the spa but not strong enough to smell it on your skin, only when you're intentionally smelling it. Philosophy is a good brand that I do trust, so I would recommend to those curious to see if it's a match for you.

I have been using this serum for a while . It leaves my skin looking radiant , smooth and healthy . It is very hydrating and the texture is pretty lightweight . I also like the sleek packaging very much .This is truly a very nice product.

Hope in a Jar biome balance glow serum is a daily serum that boasts instant hydration and smoother skin with a weeks use. You use this twice daily, which I find different from the typical serums that I've used. Morning and night application. Made with hyaluronic acid, a probiotic and AA2G which is a stabilized form of vitamin C, it's filled with things that are meant to make your skin glow and feel hydrated. When you first put it in the hand, it's a very light, almost aquatic looking and feeling serum. There's very little scent to it, if any. Which I appreciate, as while I don't mind my facial care having scent, I prefer my serums just don't. You don't need to use a lot of this, only a half dropper full which is a few drops. The first time I used it, it honestly didn't seem to work but I stuck with it and my face does feel more hydrated and it looks smoother. I've been using this for several weeks now with great success. Despite my hesitation at first, my face shows that it has worked and I am so pleased with this serum. I can't wait to see how it looks after a few months!

This serum is very runny and just melts into your skin. There is no oily residue left behind, and it absorbs fast. It works best to very gently press into your face and neck. My skin looks bright and tight, as well as hydrated. I had dry skin around my nose(had a runny nose), and after maybe 3 uses, the dry skin was gone. Great product with results.
OMG, it glow for real. I try to apply at night time and in the morning my skin so smooth and glowing. Im scared at first cause my skin so sensitive but working so good, love to try it

avis.titre: Add to your skin care routine Today
avis.texte: If I could give this product 20 stars I would. This Face moisturizer is light weight yet very hydrating to your skin and I have dry areas. I applied to my skin after a cleanse to my face and it left my skin feeling soft and smooth. I've used it for a few days now and I'm very pleased with the results results I'm seeing so far.

avis.titre: It's a no for me dawg
avis.texte: I really wanted to like this serum because it seems super simple. My skin just doesn't jive with it. It broke me out, so while I didn't use it long it's a no.
This product smells so good! It has a nice clean texture to it, leaving your skin feeling refreshed and not oily. It's a great add-on to applying moisturizer.

avis.titre: Radiance-Boosting Serum with a Silky Feel and Skin
avis.texte: The Philosophy Biome-Balance Glow Serum has a smooth, lightweight texture that glides effortlessly onto the skin and absorbs quickly without any stickiness. It feels refreshing and instantly hydrating, making it perfect for layering under moisturizer or makeup. The serum has a clean, barely-there scent that's pleasant and non-irritating, ideal for sensitive skin. Formulated with prebiotics, antioxidants, and skin-loving ingredients like hyaluronic acid and vitamin C, it helps support a healthy skin barrier while boosting radiance over time. The packaging is clean and minimal, with a convenient pump that dispenses just the right amount. A great addition for glowing, balanced skin.
The moisture this product adds to my skin routine is superb. No harsh chemicals added in this product which is a plus. No loud smells and works great with my skin regimen leaving my skin flawless
At first, I wasn't a huge fan of the feeling it left on my face. But, it made my skin so soft that I gave it a second, third, and fourth try…I'm obsessed with this
Oh, I love this product! It is definitely Hydrating! It has a nice scent to it. It comes in a glass bottle with a dropper. It feels very lightweight on the skin.
I actually really like this product the packaging is cute and people always compliment my face when i wear this. It feels good on my skin as well and there's no scent and it has great ingredients.

Great product made with effective ingredients from a brand I trust. Product went on smoothly and absorbed quickly into my skin. I felt this serum helped to protect my skin from the dry cold weather we have been experiencing leaving my skin smoother and more hydrated.

I added this to my skincare routine recently and my skin has been reacting well to the product. It's clear with a slimy consistency and fragrance free. Packaging feels luxurious and it looks great on my vanity

I have always been a fan of their philosophy products I love their lotions and with this one it's the first time that I try something like a skin care from they ran and I haven't used these for five days and I have been noticing some small changes I really like it, but to give a full opinion probably I will need to use it for more time. It promises glowing and I definitely see that after using it I don't know what else it will deliver when I start to use it more constantly, but I think that it has been doing a good job so far for this week I will update this review once I completed one month.

This new Philosophy serum is fantastic! It's actually very lightweight and applies very well to my combination skin. It doesn't feel tacky and sticky my skin feeling very smooth and clean. Overall love love love

The packaging is beautiful and sleek. The Serum spreads so nicely and leaves my skin feeling fresh. After using it my skin is noticeably less dull and I'm left glowing in a way that's hard to achieve for my skin. I really love this product so much and I would definitely purchase this product. It's worth the money full stop.
I love this serum! I struggle with dry, patchy skin and this serum makes my skin so dewy and fresh! My moisturizer sticks to the serum adding extra hydration throughout the day!

The texture is light, it absorbs quite quickly into the skin, it leaves no residue, it is quickly effective and you immediately notice your skin is more hydrated, the fragrance is soft and the presentation of the bottle is super practical.

our hope in a jar smooth-glow multi-tasking moisturizer with broad spectrum spf 30 hydrates and smooths while protecting skin from harmful UVA/UVB rays. formulated with enhanced hyaluronic acid that is carefully grafted with silicium derivate to easily assimilate with skin, the formula also contains a gentle dose of glycolic acid to gradually smooth skin, and our exclusive radiance complex to help leave skin with a healthy glow. your new go-to for protection and glow.
This serum is so good! I got to review and my skin is so soft, moisturized and glowy! I love that it has no scent so it's great for sensitive skin and it does what it says it does

I waited a few days for me too use it. I just wanna start by and say it works for my skin so well and so smoothly. I have been using it everyday nonstop and I will be getting another one. The packaging is cute and different.
Wonderful serum with great ingredients. Pregnancy safe which is a plus. Makes my skin so glowy and beautiful and it is great for day and night. Texture is wonderful

I have to say that I most definitely love this. Packaging is simple with this nice little dropper. It's super lightweight smells very light and it goes on effortless. This will be my new serum for my everyday wear night and morning.

avis.titre: Hydrating and smoothing without any side effects!
avis.texte: It's the craziest thing, but I swear that you can feel the extra hydration immediately after applying this to your skin. My face felt like I had already put on moisturizer and I hadn't yet. I have been using this for a little over a week now and I can definitely see that my skin looks more dewy and fresh which is important when you're 40! I have been recommending this to all of my friends because this is a must for your skincare routine. Moisture with added skin smoothness? YES PLEASE! I'm a convert for life!
I love this face serum. I think it has made an impact on the smoothness of my skin! I love the way it makes my face feel, and I am glad it doesn't have a scent.
This stuff is fun! I never had anything g like it before. It works really well doesn't have sent and it's made with a very nice ingredients. I like the packaging as well.
It's lightweight and not sticky . My skin is glowing and feels smoother after using. I like the slight scent of the serum. My skin feels hydrated after I use it . I recommend trying it !!

This was my first time, trying a philosophy product. The hope in a jar serum has been doing wonders for my skin. As you can see in the pictures, my face is less red and overall smoother. It is a very light sent and to be honest you can barely smell it. It goes on smooth and light. Not heavy at all.

avis.titre: Hydration and Radiance for Your Skin
avis.texte: Philosophy's Hope In A Jar Biome-Balance Glow Serum is an ultra-lightweight formula designed to provide instant hydration, leaving skin smooth, soft, and radiant while supporting the natural barrier. Enriched with enhanced hyaluronic acid for deep moisture and a prebiotic to balance the skin's microbiome, it promotes a healthy glow. Users praise its ability to absorb quickly without stickiness, noting improved skin texture and a natural, healthy radiance after consistent use. The serum's delicate scent and effectiveness make it a valuable addition to skincare routines.​ I got free as sample and opinion is my own.
I love Philosophy products. This is a great serum and made my face feel so smooth and glowy. I love the timeless packaging and as always the products have a nice scent.
This has done wonders for my skin, it has changed the texture of skin in a week! I love how easy it is to get the product out with this packaging and the scent is very neutral which I love.

This was free in exchange for an honest review. This doesn't really have a scent. The packaging is very clean and simple. Definitely gives my face that glowy look and decreases the rough looking texture I had.

I've used the other "Hope" products and have liked them in the past. This bottle is very well made and has that same milky glass that I love. After using the serum for a few weeks consistently I like it and I think it makes a difference. My only negative is that if you try to put makeup over it you have to be careful because the product can start to pill up. I've tried different ways and I haven't been able to really figure out how to make it work well under my makeup. Other than that though it's great. Perhaps I'll just use it at night.

I was very excited to try this product, its ingredients are wonderful, my face feels very hydrated from the moment I used it, even hours later, its scent is very subtle but it smells great and the skin feels and looks hydrated

avis.titre: A great and simple add to daily routine!
avis.texte: I'm always on the hunt for new skin care things to add to my routine and I was so excited to add this! It has been great so far, the texture is not too watery but also not so thick it takes a lot to put on. The simple glass bottle perfectly foreshadows the simple ingredients. It's not too sticky when patting on to your face and it has such a nice fresh and natural scent that doesn't smell chemically at all! I will definitely be using this daily and restocking!

This feels creamy and moisturising on the skin. It only has a slight smell. I love how the bottle looks on my counter and that it has clean ingredients. I wish it soaked into my skin a little easier but other than that, it is great!

I really like this serum from philosophy. It's thin so it dries down pretty quickly, so you've gotta make sure to distribute it quickly. What's nice about that is that it doesn't feel heavy on the skin. I also can't detect a scent which is good for those with sensitive skin.

avis.titre: Super hydrating serum that's great for the skin ba
avis.texte: This is a super hydrating formula that will leave your skin glowing. I love that it has probiotics and hyaluronic acid. It helps your skin Microbiome. I use it as the first step after my cleanser, and it really has dramatically increased hydration.

I have been using this biome-balance glow serum for almost a week now and love it! This serum goes on so smoothly and absorbs quickly. It has a very mild, pleasant scent. My skin has been so soft since using this!

avis.titre: One of the best Hyaluronic acid serum with prebiot
avis.texte: I am so excited to get this product from Influenster for my honest review as it is in my skincare routine. I have used many serums with Hyaluronic Acid. My cheeks has developed some dar spots over time and I use this serum together with Vitamin C serum. It helps my skin brighter and glowing. The skin texture is plump, tightened and looks healthy which I am so glad. This brand is very popular with other products and this serum is a must try if you are hesitant.

This serum looked very watery but stays on the skin more than I expected. I like it on my neck where it's sensitive and dry, but more than anything I have scars that ends up looking like wrinkles. It's pretty hopeless that that's ever going away but "hope in a jar" brand made me want to give it a run anyways. It's surprisingly thick post application and I can feel it on the skin. I think this is a good one for where you want a bit of intense rescue, and not for those with little need for the boost.

I have been using for a long time hyaluronic, prebiot and VC separate. The best of this product is include all the 3 in one. I notice, my best results using it after a shower with out drying my face and waiting for my serun to dry before using a moisturize.

This is a really nice hyaluronic serum. It feels very lightweight almost like water. A thin consistency that does not pill under makeup. I love that i can wear it under makeup or just alone in my skincare routine. It hydrates my skin and gives a beautiful glow without breaking out my acne prone skin. Great product!!

avis.titre: Get it if you want to try it!!!
avis.texte: This product does exactly what's described, it makes my face look less dull and makes it glow a little. This product also doesn't have a strong scent, and the texture is nothing I haven't experienced before. It has quality ingredients but it does come in a glass bottle but seems pretty durable. If you are thinking of trying this product i definitely would recommend it, I have never had a bad experience with philosophy.

I think that this product is going to be wonderful. The ingredients are wonderful. Doesn't have something that I'm allergic to in it. The sun is wonderful. It doesn't smell too clean, but it doesn't smell too floral. I 100% recommend this.
The applicator is very high quality. I had to use quite a bit of product because my face was so dry. It didn't leave my face feeling sticky and has no scent to it. Great product!

I love a good serum and I like a lot of Philosophys products. This come in a small bottle with a dropper applicator. It's a clear serum, it's a little thin and runnier than I like in a serum, you need one good dropperful for the entire face. It blends in easily and doesn't feel sticky or tacky. Didn't see any immediate effects but I'm hoping I will after continued use, but skin felt hydrated and refreshed. Pretty good for the cost.
Packaging is elegant just like the brand. The box says "your purchase helps us support community based mental health efforts" and that is enough for me. The scent wasn't terrible.

this feels so nice on my skin. a little definitely goes a long way and i prefer to use this at night because it does feel a little heavy. not sure if i would purchase or make a permanent part of my routine, but cute packaging doesn't hurt!

avis.titre: Glow Up: The Perfect Serum for Busy Moms & Oily Sk
avis.texte: As a busy mom and someone approaching 40 this August, keeping up with a solid skincare routine is a must for me! I need products that work without feeling like an extra chore, and Philosophy's Hope in a dropper Biome-Balance Glow Serum has been a game-changer. The packaging is super sleek and I love the white bottle! First off, let's talk about the scent—it's subtle but so nice! To me, it has a warm vanilla-amber vibe that feels cozy and luxurious but isn't overpowering. The texture is light, super moisturizing, and absorbs quickly, which is perfect for my oily skin. I can't stand heavy or greasy products, and this strikes the right balance of hydration without the shine. I also love that this serum is packed with hyaluronic acid (all the rage right now for good reason!), prebiotics, and AAG2™ to help keep my skin fresh and glowing. I've trusted Philosophy for years, and they never disappoint. If you're looking for a great daily serum that feels amazing and delivers results, this is it! Definitely repurchasing!

I absolutely love this serum as it is so lightweight on the skin, but provides excellent moisture. I tend to have oily acne prune skin so I'm always cautious about the products I use, but this formula is so water like and silky on the skin that it feels heavenly and not to clogging, which I love. Very easy to use the little temperature directly onto the skin and not waste any product. You only need a bit before your moisturizer and I feel like this product will last me a long time. I absolutely love how it sits and does not heal on the skinunder moisturizer or makeup.

I really like that the fact that the bottle is a squeeze applicator. The serum is lightweight and doesn't feel sticky. It actually smells really nice too. My skin soaked it right up. I feel like I definitely have a little more glow to my skin today!

I've been using Philosophy Hope Biome-Balance Glow Serum and I love how lightweight and hydrating it is. It absorbs quickly, leaving my skin feeling soft and refreshed without any stickiness. I've noticed a subtle, healthy glow, and my skin feels more balanced. It's gentle and hasn't caused any irritation. It has a very light pleasant scent. Overall, it's a nice addition to my skincare routine for hydration and radiance.

I've been a big fan of this brand for months, and I keep coming back because the products really work! This serum has such a smooth, lightweight texture, and my skin drinks it right up. As soon as I apply it, my skin looks fresher and feels super hydrated. I have really dry skin, and this even helps soften the fine lines on my forehead from dryness. Plus, my pores look way smaller thanks to all the hydration. Definitely a new favorite!

avis.titre: Hydrating and Smoothing. Good Vitamin C
avis.texte: This serum is okay but I'm not in love with it. It does seem to provide pretty good hydration and it does make my skin feel smoother and softer. I think it is unscented but I'm still not a fan of the smell. It smells almost like glue and does have a bit of a sticky feel to it (not much tho just very slight). I do like that it has vitamin C although I wish it showed the percentage of it. I will use it during the day because of the vitamin C properties. My skin did look smoother so it does improve skin texture. It did make my skin feel a lot more hydrated and did give it almost a bit of a "glow". Overall this product does what it says it does. However im not sure if I would pay full price for this product.
I really like this serum. It creates such a smooth surface look on my skin, it doesn't have a strong smell to it either. It definitely gives me a nice glow.

I love the Biome Balance Glow Serum! The ingredients feel clean and gentle on my skin. The texture is light and absorbs quickly, not sticky at all. The packaging is sleek and easy to use. The scent is soft and refreshing, not overpowering. After a week, my skin looks smoother and glows! Highly recommend!

This serum is unscented, pats on smoothly, and feels completely weightless on my skin. My face feels well hydrated and I do see a glow after using it. Will definitely be adding this to my daily skin care routine.
Love the scent and texture of this product! It leaves your face looking hydrated and glowy and doesn't leave any sticky residue. It's also got great packaging with an easy to use dropper.

I am really enjoying Philosophy's Biome-Balance Glow Serum. Many products are packed full of beneficial ingredients, but sometimes the combo and amount/strength in the product doesn't work well with my skin. This product has a great combo of nourishing Ingredients (like hypotonic acid and prebiotics), but leaves skin soft and smooth (and not dried out!) it absorbs easily and isn't heavily scented. My skin looks more youthful and rested. This is a new favorite!

avis.titre: Lightweight, fragrance free and skin care trend in
avis.texte: I love this serum! It's super lightweight and completely fragrance-free, which is great if you prefer unscented products. The opaque packaging is a big plus since it helps protect the formula from light and keeps it in top condition for longer. As for the ingredients, they're excellent and in line with the latest skincare trends, so this is definitely a product worth trying.

I love philosophy products in general and this one was not an exception too. Very nice texture, has a slight scent. It leaves my skin hydrated and glowing. I'm excited to add this product to my daily routine.
this product is life changing! or should i say skin changing? i immediately felt and seen the change in my skin! it's way more healthier and makes my skin so smooth! and it has a nice sleek look.
This serum is a very light formula, and it absorbs into the skin well. I have used it for a week now and can already see a slight reduction in my fine lines around my eyes!

I received this complimentary from Influenster and Philosophy in exchange for my honest review. This serum is amazing! I have aging skin and have really noticed a pore reduction! Also loving the hyaluronic acid in it, makes your skin feel so good! 10 outta 10!!
The texture is liquid and it definitely gives you a beautiful glow on your skin. It does not have a strong chemical sent the ingredients are very good and packaging is very nice.

What a lovely serum!! Incredibly lightweight and hydrating! I pressed this gently into my skin per the instructions, and was left glowing. It is lightly scented but it's not offensive. The bottle is beautiful and heavy and looks nice on my counter. Love!

I love a good serum! This Philosophy serum is a perfect serum for my dry, sensitive skin. I love serums that contain hyaluronic acid. It helps the serum work faster and more accurately. This serum leaves my skin with a beautiful glow and a soft touch.
Been using it for a month now. I've noticed an improvement in the texture and color of my skin. Age spots fading and moisturization increased. Give it a try
Don't like the liquid. Don't like how it goes on. Would not purchase it again.

I have been using Hope in a Jar for over 20 yrs. I decided to add the glow serum to my daily routine. WOW! I noticed a difference almost immediately my skin is more supple and smoother. I have already ordered my second bottle!
I used Hope In A Jar serum for years. This new version works for me.

I love the way this serum makes my face feel! A little goes a long way. Pat it in to your skin as the directions say and you will feel the amazing gentle tightening of your skin. I have used many different products that do not do as they say, but I really like this serum and I feel it lives up to what it says it does. Worth the money.

I bought this hoping it would smooth out my rough red skin and it has exceeded everything i was hoping it would. I have rosacea and psoriasis so my skin is dry scaly and red. I used this for about 4 weeks religiously day ans night and night. Now my face feels as smooth as a babys butt.

I received this as a sample a while back and had to buy it; that never happens! I'm on my third bottle already! I have pretty clear skin normally but it's sensitive and I deal with dullness. Products that are supposed to help with 'glow' usually irritate my skin - this does not! I use this every morning and get compliments on my skin all the time - even over webcam meetings! I cannot recommend this enough. Worth noting, I use a toner, then this, moisturizer and then moringa oil.

Makes my skin feel wonderful. Love Hope skin care range. It has a really nice consistency and properly absorbs into my skin and gives it the nicest glow. This is the best serum I have used and will continue to purchase .
after starting to use the serum I have noticed my skin is brighter, healthy and hydrated.

I use it with my regular skincare routine but put it on after my acne gel. It doesn't make me break out. It smells amazing! It seems a little pricey, but you get what you pay for with this product. It goes on nice, but you DO have to rub it in slowly. The texture starts to change when you try to go too fast.

I tried this product during the 30 days of beauty and honetly I knew the brand has other good products but I didnt had great expectations. I was surprised after the dirst time I used it. I used an orange looking serum by a really good brand that everyone swears about … hoever after a few days my skin needed somwthing else. This is the something else, must have unicorn in a bottle. Makes your skin look hydrated, healthy and younger.
I really tried to love this product but found that every time i used it i had an allergic reaction (bumps/rash, redness & irritation). Sadly not for me
absolutely obsessed with this. my skin is literally glowing! buying my second bottle now!
Saw and felt a huge difference. Will re buy. I recommend. So light and feels so good. I use am/pm.
I just purchased my second bottle. I received a sample size in a gift set and upon using saw positive results. I actually had a friend ask if I had some work done. Great product, highly recommend.

So I recently went on a mission to switch from my holy grail serum. I love Clarins double wear serum I used it for 3 years but the price has never set well with me. Every once in a while id try to save money and try a new serum but was always disappointed and would go back to clarins. Well, I tried again and I'm glad I did. I asked to speak to an esthetician at Ulta his name is Jose. He told me to try this! I was happy with my purchase since day one, but then a week went by and I was completely blown away. I can officially give up my habit to Clarins double-wear serum. Thank you Jose at the Salinas, Ca location.
Product works great. I am a repeat customer, because I believe in the results I see!
Only had this for one week. The firming is starting to work. Just wish it wouldn't be so expensive
